sample_mapping_evidence: Original unsorted peripheral-blood records only. Patient title prefix links repeated source timepoints. Infusion products and sorted fractions excluded; accession plus unique donor/timepoint mapping reviewed.

source_metadata.access: Public processed count triplets; raw sequence controlled
source_metadata.gene_identifier_type: Versioned Ensembl IDs and source symbols
source_metadata.expression_provenance: Deposited integer counts after author CellBender ambient removal and souporcell donor demultiplexing; not claimed to be uncorrected molecule counts.
source_metadata.time_origin: Relative to CAR-T infusion; retain actual source day for baseline specimens.
source_metadata.excluded_scope: Infusion products and sorted CAR-positive/negative fractions do not count as additional PBMC specimens.

title: Patient2-D7
extract_protocol_ch1: Viable cells were resuspended in PBS with 0.04% BSA at a cell concentration of 1000 cells/μL. 40,000 cells were loaded onto a 10x Genomics Chromium™ instrument (10x Genomics) according to the manufacturer’s instructions. The scRNA-seq libraries were processed using Chromium™ single cell 5’ library & gel bead kit and coupled scTCR-seq libraries were obtained using Chromium™ single cell V(D)J enrichment kit (human T cell) (10x Genomics). Quality control for amplified cDNA libraries and final sequencing libraries were performed using Bioanalyzer High Sensitivity DNA Kit (Agilent). Both scRNA-seq and scTCR-seq libraries were normalized to 4nM concentration and pooled in a volume ratio of 4:1. The pooled libraries were sequenced on Illumina NovaSeq S4 platform. The sequencing parameters were: Read 1 of 150bp, Read 2 of 150bp and Index 1 of 8bp.
data_processing: Alignment and transcript counting: cellranger v6.0.1
Supplementary_files_format_and_content: 10x format single cell gene expression matrices

The scRNA-seq libraries were processed using Chromium™ single cell 5’ library & gel bead kit and coupled scTCR-seq libraries were obtained using Chromium™ single cell V(D)J enrichment kit (human T cell) (10x Genomics). Quality control for amplified cDNA libraries and final sequencing libraries were performed using Bioanalyzer High Sensitivity DNA Kit (Agilent). Both scRNA-seq and scTCR-seq libraries were normalized to 4nM concentration and pooled in a volume ratio of 4:1. The pooled libraries were sequenced on Illumina NovaSeq S4 platform. The sequencing parameters were: Read 1 of 150bp, Read 2 of 150bp and Index 1 of 8bp.
data_processing: Alignment and transcript counting: cellranger v6.0.1
Supplementary_files_format_and_content: 10x format single cell gene expression matrices
